text:
Tariq (ACME Mobile): Hey team — started seeing a bunch of 429s this morning from our integration. We're on the free tier and haven't changed traffic patterns intentionally. Rough timeline: 07:40 UTC a few failed requests, 07:45 full cascade. Getting backoff floods from iOS clients after flaky mobile network. Example error: `HTTP 429, \"rate_limit_exceeded\"` and header `x-rw-retry-after: 30`. Any chance of a temporary lift? We're effectively blocked for login flows.

Elena (Support): Hi @Tariq — sorry about that. Can you paste your org ID and the request id from a failed call (X-Request-ID/Request-Id)? Also, how many requests/min are you seeing, and do you have any recent deploys that changed retry logic?

Tariq (ACME Mobile): Org: org_ACME_72. Sample request id: req_8f3a9c. We were seeing ~70 req/min for a short burst but most are retries in <1s intervals. No deploys; we did push an app update two days ago but nothing touching backoff.

Elena (Support): Thanks — forwarding to eng to check quota/burst rules. @Nina can you search logs for org_ACME_72 around 07:40-07:55 UTC? Also filing a quick ticket: OpsBot created INC-2026 for tracking.

Nina (Eng): Looking now. Quick findings: free tier has a per-minute soft cap of 60 req/min and short-term burst smoothing that allows spikes up to ~120 req/min for <30s before throttling. I can see repeated token refresh attempts from the mobile SDK that retried immediately (no jitter), causing an effective retry storm.

Kevin (SRE): Adding to that — logs show a client retry loop with exponential backoff misconfigured to 0.5s base and no max jitter. That turns 5 failed upstream calls into 10-20 attempts in 10s window. We surface 429s and then client retries again, making it worse.

Tariq (ACME Mobile): Ugh, that matches. Our iOS SDK has a bug where network failures trigger immediate retry x3 before backoff kicks in. We'll patch. In the meantime can we get a short-lived higher burst limit so login flows aren't failing? Customers are hitting the app.

Sam (Sales): @Elena @Tariq I can approve a temporary trial of paid-tier burst handling — 48h elevated burst allowance and a one-week grace on billing while you triage, subject to billing contact confirmation. Tariq, who is the billing contact and does ACME have a PO on file?

Tariq (ACME Mobile): Billing contact is Lina (lina@acme). We don't have a PO yet. 48h would be great.

Elena (Support): Ok we can do a short exception. Two things: (1) Ops will enable a 2-hour elevated burst window for org_ACME_72 right away (automation: set temporary_override=true), (2) Sales will own the 48h paid trial escalation to prevent reoccurrence. After that we'll need to move to a paid plan or reduce client retries.

Nina (Eng): Implementing a short-term override now. For record, suggested mitigations on your side: add jitter to retries, cap max attempts to 3, and apply per-device cooldown (eg 60s) after N consecutive 429s. Example quick fix in pseudo-code:

```
// exponential backoff with jitter
retryDelay = base * 2**attempt + random(0, base)
maxAttempts = 3
```

Kevin (SRE): Confirmed override applied at 07:57 UTC. We bumped burst allowance to 180 req/min for the next 2 hours for org_ACME_72. Watch metrics: token_rate and burst_window in the console. Also adding a short alert if sustained >120 req/m for >5m.

OpsBot: INC-2026 updated: temporary_override=true, override_expires=2026-06-12T09:57:00Z, assigned_to=Sam (Sales).

Sam (Sales): I'll reach out to Lina now to confirm billing contact and offer a 14-day eval of Dedicated with predictable throughput if desired. If ACME wants to proceed we can convert the temp exception into a formal trial and loop in finance.

Tariq (ACME Mobile): Thanks all. We'll roll the SDK patch within the hour and monitor. Can you leave notes on the incident with recommended post-mortem items? Also, any guidance on what traffic profile qualifies for auto-upgrade recommendations?

Elena (Support): We'll add a post-mortem checklist to INC-2026: root cause (client retry storm), mitigation (temporary burst override), long-term (paid plan or client patch), follow-up (sales outreach). For auto-upgrade: currently we recommend sales contact when sustained >70% of soft cap for 24h or repeated >3 bursts/week. I'll paste that into the ticket.

Nina (Eng): FYI — adding a small server-side heuristic to detect immediate retry storms and return `Retry-After` with progressive backoff headers to break loops. Not a replacement for client fix but helps reduce cascade effects.

Tariq (ACME Mobile): Great. I'll confirm once the patch is rolled. Appreciate the quick handoff and the temporary lift. :clap:

Elena (Support): Closing loop here but keeping INC-2026 open until post-mortem and sales handoff are complete. If anything changes ping this thread or DM.
